name: guidecursor-monorepo
description: Non-blocking product walkthroughs with an animated guide cursor.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @guidecursor/core && npm run build -w @guidecursor/react
scripts.test: npm run test -w @guidecursor/core && npm run test -w @guidecursor/react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @guidecursor/core && npm run typecheck -w @guidecursor/react && npm run typecheck -w @guidecursor/demo
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
